Here it fires IonBolt (Electricity damage, which player shield packs cannot absorb). It mounts at any angle ($TurretLocAnywhere), including on Deployable Platforms. Area limits follow the mod-wide rules: up to 8 other range-finding turrets in a 35x35x25 m box, 4 m from another Ion Turret.

Deploys through Turret::deployShape: aim within 3 m at terrain, a building or a Deployable Platform; not within 40% of the flag-to-flag distance of the enemy flag (2-team maps); no more than 8 range-finding turrets of any type already in a 35x35x25 m box, and none of the same type within a 4 m box. Builder mode ($build) skips the team limit and does not use up the pack.
Carried by Assault, Deffence and Destroyer; team limit 10.
TurretPack.source: turretIonTurret.cs; turret.cs Turret::deployShape, CountTurrets; game.cs turret box globals; sources/base/item.cs TurretPack::deployShape

IrradiationTurretPack.summary: Deploys the Irradiation Cannon, a ground turret with no auto-targeting that only fires while a player controls it.
notes: Its range is 0, so it never picks targets by itself (mounting the pack says so). It also does not count toward the area turret limit. Walking into it gives you manual control; a Laptop lets you take over an enemy one.
Fires IrradiationBlast, a rapid bullet with a 5 m blast. The datablock sets baseDamageType, not damageType, so its damage type is unclear. Behavior not determined from scripts.

Ground only. Deploys through Turret::deployShape: aim within 3 m at terrain, a building or a Deployable Platform; not within 40% of the flag-to-flag distance of the enemy flag (2-team maps); no more than 8 range-finding turrets of any type already in a 35x35x25 m box, and none of the same type within a 4 m box. Builder mode ($build) skips the team limit and does not use up the pack.
Not sold at remote inventory stations. Carried by the DM armors, Assault, Deffence and Destroyer; team limit 2.
IrradiationTurretPack.source: turretIrradiationTurret.cs; turret.cs Turret::deployShape, CountTurrets, Turret::onCollision; baseProjData.cs IrradiationBlast

LaserTurretPack.summary: Deploys a small camera-shaped laser turret that can go on any surface angle.
notes: Fires TurretLaser (Laser damage). Laser hits on players spawn a blood effect, and head hits on Borg, Heavy or Destroyer from the middle quadrants do 45% extra.

Mounts on floors, walls or ceilings. It has no shield. Deploys through Turret::deployShape: aim within 3 m at terrain, a building or a Deployable Platform; not within 40% of the flag-to-flag distance of the enemy flag (2-team maps); no more than 8 range-finding turrets of any type already in a 35x35x25 m box, and none of the same type within a 4 m box. Builder mode ($build) skips the team limit and does not use up the pack.
Only Deffence can carry it; team limit 16.

RocketPack.summary: Deploys a ground Missile Turret that fires seeking missiles at hot targets.
notes: verifyTarget only accepts targets with a heat factor of at least 0.5, so it locks onto jetting players and vehicles. Vehicle::getHeatFactor always returns 1.0, so vehicles are always valid targets.
Fires TurretMissile (Missile damage, 9.5 m radius, heavy kickback). It cannot be manually controlled by touch ($CanControl 0) and deals a large debris blast when destroyed.

Ground only. Deploys through Turret::deployShape: aim within 3 m at terrain, a building or a Deployable Platform; not within 40% of the flag-to-flag distance of the enemy flag (2-team maps); no more than 8 range-finding turrets of any type already in a 35x35x25 m box, and none of the same type within a 4 m box. Builder mode ($build) skips the team limit and does not use up the pack.
Carried by Deffence and Borg; team limit 6.
RocketPack.source: turretMissileTurret.cs DeployableRocket::verifyTarget; vehicle.cs Vehicle::getHeatFactor; turret.cs Turret::deployShape

MortarTurretPack.summary: Deploys a ground Mortar Turret that lobs heavy mortar shells at enemies in range.
notes: Fires MortarTurretShell (Mortar damage, 30 m radius).

When mounted, the pack says the turret has no auto-sensor and must be controlled manually. That message is wrong: its datablock has range 100, so it targets on its own, and $CanControl is 0, so you cannot take it over by touch.
MortarTurretPack::onUse is defined twice, with the same body.

Ground only. Deploys through Turret::deployShape: aim within 3 m at terrain, a building or a Deployable Platform; not within 40% of the flag-to-flag distance of the enemy flag (2-team maps); no more than 8 range-finding turrets of any type already in a 35x35x25 m box, and none of the same type within a 4 m box. Builder mode ($build) skips the team limit and does not use up the pack.
Only Deffence can carry it; team limit 2.

NuclearTurretPack.summary: Deploys a short-range Nuclear Turret (indoor gun) that fires very powerful NukeShell rockets. It can be placed at any angle.
notes: NukeShell does Missile damage with heavy kickback in a 9.5 m radius. Its damage is far above every other turret's on this mod's scale, but the turret's range is short.

Mounts on floors, walls or ceilings. Deploys through Turret::deployShape: aim within 3 m at terrain, a building or a Deployable Platform; not within 40% of the flag-to-flag distance of the enemy flag (2-team maps); no more than 8 range-finding turrets of any type already in a 35x35x25 m box, and none of the same type within a 4 m box. Builder mode ($build) skips the team limit and does not use up the pack.
Only Deffence can carry it; team limit 2.

ParticleBeamTurretPack.summary: Deploys the Particle Beam Turret: a manual-only ground turret that fires a strong beam.
notes: Range 0: it never fires on its own and is excluded from the area turret count. Walk into it to control it (embedded controller); with a Laptop you can take over an enemy one.
Fires the ParticleBeam laser (Laser damage). Its damage conversion is far above the Laser Turret's (4 vs 0.0065).

Ground only. Deploys through Turret::deployShape: aim within 3 m at terrain, a building or a Deployable Platform; not within 40% of the flag-to-flag distance of the enemy flag (2-team maps); no more than 8 range-finding turrets of any type already in a 35x35x25 m box, and none of the same type within a 4 m box. Builder mode ($build) skips the team limit and does not use up the pack.
Carried by the DM armors, Assault, Deffence and Destroyer; team limit 2.

PlasmaTurretPack.summary: Deploys a ground Plasma Turret that fires fast plasma bolts which set targets on fire. You can take control of it by touch.
notes: Fires Plasmacharge (Plasma damage). Plasma damage on a player triggers Armor::onBurn, which sets them burning.
The Plasmacharge datablock sets liveTime twice (11.0, then 1.0). The later value applies.
Touch it to control it manually; with a Laptop you can take over an enemy one. It deals a large debris blast when destroyed.

Ground only. Deploys through Turret::deployShape: aim within 3 m at terrain, a building or a Deployable Platform; not within 40% of the flag-to-flag distance of the enemy flag (2-team maps); no more than 8 range-finding turrets of any type already in a 35x35x25 m box, and none of the same type within a 4 m box. Builder mode ($build) skips the team limit and does not use up the pack.
Carried by Assault, Deffence and Borg; team limit 8.
PlasmaTurretPack.source: turretPlasmaTurret.cs; baseProjData.cs Plasmacharge; player.cs Player::onDamage; armorData.cs Armor::onBurn

ShockTurretPack.summary: Deploys a short-range Shock Turret whose concussion shells fry the target's energy.
notes: Fires ShockShell (Shock damage, 30 m radius). Shock damage on a player calls Armor::onShock: energy is set to 0 at once, and shock effects (ShockedDamage, and ShockJet while jetting) run every 0.5 s for about 10 s. Heavy armor's onShock is commented out, so Heavy is immune.

Mounts on floors, walls or ceilings. Deploys through Turret::deployShape: aim within 3 m at terrain, a building or a Deployable Platform; not within 40% of the flag-to-flag distance of the enemy flag (2-team maps); no more than 8 range-finding turrets of any type already in a 35x35x25 m box, and none of the same type within a 4 m box. Builder mode ($build) skips the team limit and does not use up the pack.
onAdd sets a recharge rate of 6, but onEnabled sets it back to 5.
Only Deffence can carry it; team limit 8.

vortexTurretPack.summary: Deploys a camera-sized Vortex Turret that does no damage but pulls targets toward it.
notes: Fires vortexBolt: damage 0 (TurretVortexDamageType) with kickback -300, so each hit yanks the target toward the impact point instead of pushing it away.

Mounts on floors, walls or ceilings. It has no shield. Deploys through Turret::deployShape: aim within 3 m at terrain, a building or a Deployable Platform; not within 40% of the flag-to-flag distance of the enemy flag (2-team maps); no more than 8 range-finding turrets of any type already in a 35x35x25 m box, and none of the same type within a 4 m box. Builder mode ($build) skips the team limit and does not use up the pack.
Only Deffence can carry it; team limit 6.
Only the DM armor, Light and Assassin suits can carry it (200 each), matching the Disc Launcher's carry list. Every spawn starts with 200.
One disc per shot; the script is unchanged from stock Tribes.

RepairPack.summary: The stock repair backpack and Repair Gun, but its beam repairs far faster than in stock Tribes. Every suit can carry one, and every spawn gets one already switched on.
notes: Pack and gun scripts match stock. The change is in RepairBolt::onAcquire: self-repair adds an auto-repair rate of 100 (stock 0.05) and repairing another target adds 50 (stock 0.1), so repairs finish almost at once.
Repairing an object first goes through fixable(), which refuses map turrets, inventory stations, generators or vehicle stations when an admin has disabled that class of object.
Repairing an enemy object is allowed; the message names it as 'enemy'.

ShieldPack.summary: The stock energy shield backpack: while on, incoming damage drains energy instead of health.
notes: Pack script matches stock (shield strength 0.012). Unlike stock, Player::onDamage gives it no effect at all against Electricity damage, and it absorbs only 75% as well against shrapnel and mortar damage.
Carried by the DM armor, Assault, Borg and Destroyer suits. Light, Assassin, Deffence and Heavy cannot use it.

SensorJammerPack.summary: The stock personal sensor jammer backpack: while on it raises your sensor suppression by 20 so enemy sensors lose you.
notes: Script matches stock.
Carried by the DM armor, Light, Assault, Heavy and Destroyer suits and the male Deffence suit. The female Deffence (fdf column 0), Assassin and Borg cannot carry it.
